findings.summary: M16 evidence is substantively correct but its stated derivation is wrong. The tree carries 152 pre-existing cases and 171 total, which matches the spec baseline exactly and is corroborated by the inherited A8a acceptance record (.dd-evidence/acceptance.json: 'Tests 152 passed', with per-file counts identical to the current tree). The dev-note explains this as '151 it( + it.each 展开 1 条'; the actual arithmetic is 149 `it(` lines outside tick-run.test.ts plus 3 loop-expanded cases from the `for (const ext of [...])` block at test/ingest.test.ts:291-295 (there is no `it.each` anywhere in test/). Totals are right, the breakdown is not.

assembleBoard and computeInspect gained a required `runs` parameter, which is a change to an existing exported signature and sits in tension with §6 ('不改既有导出签名，确需新增则新增'). It appears unavoidable: keeping the old arity would have left a hardcoded empty-runs literal on the production path, which M6 greps for and X1 targets. All in-repo callers (src/tick-entry.ts, src/tick-inspect.ts, test/tick-inspect.test.ts) are updated and there are no external consumers, so no breakage results.

assembleBoard still sets `retries: 0` on every card, so on a real board card.retries is a constant and the M4 (retry+1 → open) and M5 (retries=2 → blocked) branches of decideTick remain unreachable in production, exercised only by synthetic pure-data inputs. This is structurally the same constant-input defect that motivated this package for `runs`. Persisting retries is out of scope here (ClueV2 has no retries field and §6 forbids touching src/protocol.ts), and runWrite correspondingly never propagates Decision.retries into the CAS payload. Recorded as carry-forward scope for A8c, not as a defect of this package.
